notes: THE HEADLINE: a returning member navigating in-app to Options Flow on a live RTH tape gets the shell in 542 ms (median, worst 648 ms) and the TOP_PICKS product in 2020 ms (median, worst 3945 ms), on 134 KB of wire, entirely over parts. Picks rendered on 6 of 6 runs. The bimodal no-picks failure did NOT reproduce in any of these runs. Run 3 is the single most informative run of the session and feeds item 13: a version roll landed mid-load and the client re-fetched across three versions -- 14 requests instead of 5, 870 KB instead of 134 KB, 6.5x the bytes -- and STILL rendered picks, at 3945 ms. That is the storm shape, it is real, it is caused by a roll arriving during load, and on this evidence it degrades the number rather than breaking the render.
